{{Quote|I am BNI-393, an LEP servant droid. My master called me Bunny.|BNI-393, revealing who she is to D-Squad|<ref name="Point of No Return">{{TCW|Point of No Return (The Clone Wars)}}</ref>}}
'''BNI-393''', nicknamed '''Bunny''', was an [[LEP servant droid/Legends|LEP servant droid]] that helped [[Meebur Gascon/Legends|Meebur Gascon]] and the [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]].

==Biography==
[[File:BNI393-PoNR.png|thumb|left|250px|"Bunny" addresses D-Squad]]
Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], BNI-393 served aboard the [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Renown/Legends|Renown]]'' when it was hijacked by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Battle droid/Legends|forces]] to use as a bomb to destroy the [[Valor (space station)/Legends|Valor]], the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Carida system/Legends|Carida system]] hosting the [[Republic strategy conference/Legends|Republic strategy conference]]. During the hijack, [[BNI-393's master/Legends|BNI's master]] was killed along with the rest of the clone personnel, but she survived with a small group of other droids. BNI managed to learn the identity of the target the Separatists planned to destroy and revealed it to [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]] when she hoped to escape the ship when the ''Renown'' exited [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].

When a [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|buzz droid]] was caught spying on the droid survivors, [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] chased the droid into the gunnery room followed by BNI and the others. The droids were later ambushed by a swarm of buzz droids, and [[M5-BZ/Legends|M5-BZ]] sacrificed himself to remove the buzz droids from the room. He opened an airlock, which sent the buzz droids into hyperspace, along with himself, in order to to save the others. BNI and the others later escaped the doomed Star Destroyer on a [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] before it exploded, sending a catastrophic wave of debris to the station and the fleet around it. BNI and the others were later returned to safety under the protection of the Republic and were all assigned to the same squad for the rest of the war as it escalated.
